programme.desc: Alle zwei Jahre lädt die Land Rover Experience Tour Abenteurer ein, die entlegensten Gebiete der Welt zu erkunden. Im Jahr 2017 war das Ziel Peru. Teil 4 von 4.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Para a BMW tuner Manhart Racing, o Nürburgring Nordschleife é o lugar ideal para comemorar seu 25º aniversário. Como parte dos Track Days, clientes e partes interessadas têm a oportunidade de conhecer os modelos Manhart.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Uma vez por ano, os fãs de afinação de carros de todo o país se encontram no Neue Messe Dresden para o XS Carnight. Em 35.000 metros quadrados há sonhos de carros a serem vistos aqui enquanto as luzes se apagam do lado de fora.

programme.title: Subaru Forester e-Boxer 2020 - Subarus erster Hybrid
programme.desc: Der Forester e-Boxer ist der erste Hybrid von Subaru in Europa. Dabei bleibt die japanischer Marke ihren Grundsatzen treu: Allradantrieb und Boxer-Benziner. Wie spielt das mit der neuen Hybrid-Technik zusammen? Und wie gut funktioniert der Antrieb? Das testen wir in der Lausitz Onroad und Offroad.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Ao contrário das inúmeras reuniões do carro Show & Shine, no Rust'n'Roll quanto mais velho melhor. Somente quando os veículos parecem realmente velhos e enferrujados, são considerados bonitos.

programme.title: An Bord bei der Rekordfahrt des Porsche 911 GT2 RS
programme.desc: Porsche hat mit dem 911 GT2 RS einen neuen Rekord für straßenzugelassene Sportwagen auf der 20,6 Kilometer langen Nürburgring-Nordschleife aufgestellt. Die am 20. September im Beisein eines Notars erzielte Bestzeit von 6.47,3 Minuten übertraf selbst interne Erwartungen. Quelle: Porsche

programme.title: Alpen Marathon
programme.desc: Eine Motorradtour durch das Zentralmassiv. Wir lernen in der Ardèche die facettenreiche Landschaft, Sehenswürdigkeiten, interessante Leute und beste französische Küche kennen. Ein Einblick mit vielen Tipps in einen noch größtenteils unentdeckten Teil Frankreichs.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A NitrolympX é um evento esportivo motorizado que foi realizado pela primeira vez em Hockenheim, em 1986. Com cerca de 30.000 espectadores e cerca de 300 participantes, é o maior evento internacional de drag race da Europa.

programme.title: Alpen Marathon
programme.desc: Eine Motorradtour durch Slowenien von den östlichen Alpenpässen bis hinunter ans Meer. Wir lernen die vielseitige Landschaft, einen Motorradrestaurator, interessante Leute und beste slowenische Küche, Brauer- und Winzer-Kultur kennen. Teil 1 von 2.

programme.title: Um Fusca afinado!
programme.desc: Parece um Volkswagen Fusca dos anos setenta. Mas com afinação contemporânea, potência de 90 cavalos e velocidade máxima de 112 mph, promete prazer de dirigir sem limites.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Os novos descapotáveis e a luz do sol pertencem apenas um ao outro. Nós testamos os novos descapotáveis da série 6 da BMW na Table Mountain, na África do Sul.

programme.title: Alpen Marathon
programme.desc: Eine Motorradtour durch den Westen Sloweniens entlang dem türkisfarbenen Fluss Soca, von den Alpenpässen Mangart und Vrsic bis hinab ans Meer. Mit Interviews zu Geschichte und Kultur und Tipps zu Kulinarik und den schönsten Routen. Teil 2 von 2.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A Audi construiu 333 unidades de seu modelo GT, e a mudança de marcha do carro mostra três zeros. O motorista de testes Patrick tentará descobrir do que se trata e ver o que 560 HP podem fazer na condução diária.

programme.title: 1966 Skoda Trekka: Warum es vom „Defender des Ostens“ heute nur rund 10 Stück in Europa gibt
programme.desc: Der Trekka, von Skoda konzipiert, in Neuseeland montiert, ist dort Landes-Kulturerbe. Dabei gibt es in Europa nicht einmal 10 fahrtüchtige Exemplare. Zwei von ihnen sind erst seit kurzem im Besitz von Skoda. Der „verlorene Sohn“ kehrt zurück.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Hoje se trata de um peso leve no segmento de classe alta alemã, o Audi A6 2.0 TDI. Mais eficiência, menos peso e mais esportividade é o que o fabricante promove para vencer a corrida contra a BMW e a Mercedes.

programme.title: Realer wird’s nicht! | BMW M Driving Experience integriert Mixed Reality
programme.desc: Das Auto ist echt – die Strecke virtuell. Mixed Reality könnte die Gaming-Welt revolutionieren. Wir probieren die neue Technik bei einem Drifttraining der BMW M Driving Academy aus.

programme.title: Selbstfahrende Autos – bald auch in Europa | Mercedes Insight Drive Pilot 95 | Motorvision
programme.desc: Autonom fahrende Autos – wie weit ist die Technik? Bei der Vorstellung von Mercedes‘ neuem Insight Drive Pilot 95 geben wir einen Überblick über die verschiedenen Level und was der Drive Pilot kann.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Colocamos à prova os 555 HP do Wiesmann MF5 no hipódromo de Spa-Francochamps, nas Ardenas Belgas. Um projeto excepcional de carro esportivo, 8 cilindros, motor bi-turbo. Ele pode competir com Ferrari ou Porsche?

programme.title: Go Green
programme.sub-title: Von Oslo nach Frankfurt im Kia EV6 GT
programme.desc: Reichweite ist einer der kritischsten Punkte, wenn es um Elektromobilität geht. Wir fahren in einem Praxistest mit einem Kia EV6 GT von Oslo nach Frankfurt.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A corrida de 24 horas no Nürburgring é considerada a corrida de longa distância mais difícil nos esportes motorizados. A Volkswagen colocou a si mesma este desafio com um carro realmente especial.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.sub-title: Mit Apps unterwegs - Der Verkehr der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Mobilität steht vor einem großen Umbruch. Treiber dieser Transformation ist neben Krisen wie der Klimawandel und die Corona-Pandemie auch die Digitalisierung. Die Zukunft des Verkehrs wird zunehmend per App und Algorithmen gesteuert. Wir erklären die neuesten Trends und Begriffe der digitalen Mobilität – von Sharing bis Micromobilität.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Mercedes SL65 AMG é o último modelo alemão de carro de força em um terno feito sob medida.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Die Automobil-Branche wandelt sich gerade komplett: Fahrzeuge entwickeln sich zu autonom fahrenden, voll vernetzten Digital-Devices. Die Verkehrssicherheit soll sich stark verbessern. Aber wie funktionieren Assistenz-Systeme eigentlich? Und wie sicher sind selbstfahrende PKW? MOTORVISION schaut Ingenieuren von Daimler über die Schulter - kurz vor dem Launch der neuen S-Klasse im Herbst 2017.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: O grande vencedor nas 24 horas de Le Mans. O Jaguar D-Type ganhou a prova de enduro mais dura do mundo três vezes seguidas.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da BMW
programme.desc: Prazer de dirigir: A BMW, um dos grupos automotivos de maior sucesso do mundo, promete exatamente isso. Os carros e motos esportivos da Bavarian Motorenwerke AG são igualmente populares entre os clientes e nos esportes de corrida.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Aboard one of the world's biggest cruise liners, we show how broadband internet on the high seas works, visit the control center of the SES' satellite fleet and take a peek at a test aircraft.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o Porsche "James Dean", a Spyder 550. É pequeno, plano e rápido. E foi construído apenas 140 vezes. Mas mesmo assim, a aranha Porsche 550 escreve a história. E é o carro em que a lenda de Hollywood, James Dean, morre em um acidente. A História Automotiva conta toda a história do carro dos sonhos dos anos 50.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Moderne LKW bieten neue Technologien und Funktionen, die das Fahren einfacher und effizienter machen sollen. Wir haben den schwedischen Hersteller Volvo Trucks besucht und einen Blick auf die Produktion deren neuer Automatisierungssysteme geworfen.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Seja em Rallye, Circuito ou Indianápolis. Por mais de 100 anos, as corridas têm sido a força motriz da Ford. Os heróis daquela época são agora lendas.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Saubere und sichere Mobilität ist eine der großen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bezahlbar, nachhaltig, komfortabel und rund um die Uhr erhältlich soll es sein. Das sind große Anforderungen, die aber auch Innovationen begünstigen. Motorvision stellt vor, wie die Zukunft in Sachen Personen und Warentransport aussieht.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: A BMW é um dos fabricantes de automóveis de maior sucesso no mundo. Desde o início, as corridas têm sido um dos principais componentes. E a transferência de tecnologia é uma grande vantagem, especialmente para os clientes.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher können heute zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit online einkaufen und erwarten, dass alles pünktlich ankommt. Doch wie funktioniert das alles so reibungslos, sicher und pünktlich? Wie meistert die Logistikbranche solche Herausforderungen?

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Nos anos 80 e 90, a Porsche corre de vitória em vitória. Uma McLaren vence três vezes a Copa do Mundo de Fórmula 1 com a Porsche power. A Porsche de 1982 começa uma série de vitórias em Le Mans. As décadas de 1980, 1990 e 2000 são os anos dourados do automobilismo para a Porsche. A História Automotiva mostra os carros mais rápidos, as corridas mais emocionantes e os pilotos mais famosos.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Mobilität ist eines der großen Themen unserer Zeit. Überall werden die diversesten Verkehrsmittel genutzt. Wie gehen Mobilitätsexperten mit dieser Entwicklung um? Ein gutes Beispiel dafür ist "versteckte Hightech" wie Beschichtung und 3D-Druck.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: O Glas GT parece uma Ferrari, mas vem da província da Baixa Baviera, na Alemanha. No início dos anos 60, era um dos poucos carros esportivos alemães.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: A Peugeot lançou este clássico, todo monstro de tração nas rodas com um único propósito: deveria trazer o Campeonato Mundial de Rally para a França. O Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 sacudiu o mundo do rali nos anos 80.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Seit 2008 baut BMW Hybridfahrzeuge, deren Emissionen und Verbrauch um mindestens ein Drittel niedriger sind als die konventioneller Pendants. Außerdem: Kohlenstoff- und Naturfasern bei der Herstellung von Karosserie- und Innenraumteilen.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Que alegria é quando a elegância encontra um desempenho extraordinário! O Maserati Quattroporte, o Kelleners BMW GranCoupe e o 911 4S da Porsche. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes excelentes exemplos de poder combinados com estilo.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Wir haben versucht, den Weltrekord zu brechen, indem wir mit einem wasserstoffbetriebenen Auto, dem Hyundai Nexo, mehr als 2.000 Kilometer von Stockholm nach Paris gefahren sind. Wasserstofffahrzeuge scheinen noch ein Schattendasein zu führen.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Test Days
programme.desc: Duas semanas antes do início das famosas 24 horas da corrida de Le Mans, todas as equipas estão ocupadas a testar os seus carros na pista tradicional de longa distância em França, com mau tempo, com acidentes e muita tensão.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 mostra uma modéstia estilística como nenhum outro carro desportivo. Não se vangloria e evita qualquer aparência ruidosa. Explorámos a história por detrás deste icónico carro desportivo. Para além disso: O 911 Turbo S da Porsche.

programme.title: VW ID.7 - Erste Testfahrt mit dem Elektro-Passat
programme.desc: Er soll den VW Passat ins Elektro-Zeitalter führen. Der ID.7 kommt zum Marktstart in einer PRO-Variante mit 77 kWh-Batterie. Kann er den Erfolg des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners weiterführen? Wir testen die Elektro-Limousine um Marseille in Frankreich.

programme.title: Porsche Cayenne Turbo E-Hybrid
programme.desc: 739 PS, 950 Nm Drehmoment! Er ist der bisher stärkste Cayenne aller Zeiten. Wie performt das Porsche-SUV mit sportlichem GT-Paket auf Rennstrecke und Landstraße? Und kann sportlich gleichzeitig auch sparsam sein?

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: Mais extremos são sempre possíveis. O veículo militar Laplander da Volvo tem 6 rodas, 3 eixos e oferece espaço para pelo menos 12 soldados.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: A Aston Martin está buscando sucesso futuro com seu modelo DB11. Além do belo novo design, os turbos são usados pela primeira vez, mas, para não se preocupar, o magnífico V12 permanece no lugar.

programme.title: Neuer Kleinster bei Volvo - Wir testen den vollelektrischen EX30.
programme.desc: „Downsizing“ bei Volvo – mit dem EX30 bringen die Schweden ein komplett neues kleines Elektro-SUV auf den Markt. Der Einstiegspreis ist verhältnismäßig günstig. Bietet der EX30 Premium-Qualität und Sicherheit zum guten Preis? Wir machen den Test.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Apesar de um número de produção de quase 1,4 milhões de unidades, o Chevrolet Corvair é praticamente desconhecido na Europa. Ele era inovador, eficiente, moderno e barato. No entanto, foi caluniado, despedaçado e mais tarde insultado.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG S 63 E Performance
programme.desc: 802 PS, 1430 Nm Drehmoment! Der AMG S 63 E Performance ist die stärkste S-Klasse, die bisher in Serie gebaut wird. Doch wie gut gelingt der Mix aus Luxus und Sportlichkeit? Wir checken den neuen AMG in Kalifornien und blicken auf seine Historie.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.sub-title: Herois de acrobacias - Especial - Aspectos destacados de las acrobacias
programme.desc: Este episódio apresenta os melhores momentos de Action Concept de todos os especiais anteriores, desde acrobacias emocionantes de carros até cenas de luta coreografadas meticulosamente e até mesmo alguma ação com motos de neve. Os Stunt Heroes fazem o melhor que podem para competir com seus colegas de Hollywood de grande orçamento.

programme.title: Performance-Hybride
programme.desc: Hybride mit Power erobern die Straßen. Der McLaren Artura kombiniert revolutionäre Hybridtechnologie mit Rennsport-DNA. Auch Ferrari setzt beim 296 GTB auf kombinierte Power aus Strom und Benzin. Außerdem: Mercedes S 580e und Cupra Leon Sportstourer.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.desc: Desta vez, um parque industrial é o cenário da extravagância acrobática da Action Concept. O objetivo dos Stunt Heroes: saltar através do trailer de um caminhão com um carro. Como de costume com tais acrobacias arriscadas, planejamento, preparação, tempo e precisão são essenciais.

programme.title: Kurvenräuber
programme.desc: Was ist die Essenz von Sportwagen? Leistung? Präzision? Oder das unvergleichliche Gefühl, die Straße zu beherrschen. Zum Beispiel im McLaren 600 LT, Aston Martin Vantage oder Alfa Romeo Giulia GTAm.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.desc: Numa corrida entre um basculante e um carro, homem e máquina são empurrados ao limite. Os heróis de ação da Action Concept exploram todas as possibilidades de usar um caminhão basculante em cenas de ação, e o duplo Koini recebe uma carga de cascalho para seu aniversário em vez de confetes.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: Power-Sport-Kombis
programme.desc: Power-Sport-Kombis sind Familienautos mit Sportwagen-DNA. Der Audi RS6 hat sich über Jahrzehnte vom unauffälligen Familienwagen zum technologischen Meisterwerk entwickelt. Doch auch seine Konkurrenz ist nicht zu unterschätzen.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: A Ferrari California T tem muita paixão italiana e linhas elegantes para oferecer. Cabriolets de super carros esportivos são populares em todo o mundo. Não é de admirar que cada vez mais fabricantes estejam "abrindo".

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: Com a Active Hybrid 7, ao contrário de sua antecessora com o mesmo nome de modelo, BMW agora conta com um híbrido completo, que também pode ser acionado exclusivamente com energia elétrica.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: A Escalada de Pikes Peak Hill de 1987. Um tipo de corrida bastante diferente nas montanhas do Colorado, EUA. É única, fascinante e cheia de aventura.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Dakar
programme.desc: Egal ob onroad oder offroad – er soll alles meistern. Der Porsche 911 Dakar ist einer der extremsten Serien-11er aller Zeiten. Wir testen den außergewöhnlichen 911 im Gelände und klären, wie es zu diesem besonderen Konzept kam.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Desde 1934, o Grande Prêmio tem sido o campeonato mundial mais emocionante e fascinante do mundo. Com seus veículos de última geração, com a potência das maiores marcas, ela nunca deixa de impressionar seus espectadores.

programme.title: BMW M2
programme.desc: Kompakte High-Performance-Modelle haben bei BMW eine langjährige Tradition. Vom 2002 turbo, über das 1er M Coupe bis zum aktuellen M2. Die zweite Generation ist ein Track-Tool mit Alltagsqualitäten. Oder umgekehrt? Wir machen den Test.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: Rallye Ano 1972 - Uma Historia de Sucesso Ford
programme.desc: O Campeonato Internacional de Fabricantes foi uma série de rallys de 1970-72. Fabricantes de automóveis como Porsche, Renault e Ford participaram, com a Ford tendo um ano de excepcional sucesso em 1972.

programme.title: BMW-Power
programme.desc: Von Rennstreckenlegenden bis zu sportlichen Luxusstraßenkreuzern: Keiner schafft den Spagat zwischen Fahrspaß und Komfort so gut wie BMW. Die Rennstrecken-Ikone M4 CSL im Test. Und: Ist der BMW M760e mehr Fahrerlimousine oder Chauffeurswagen?

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Speed Dating
programme.desc: 27 Derivate - nie war die Auswahl an Porsche 911ern so groß. Und noch nie konnte man alle Modelle auf einem Fleck begutachten – bis heute! Wir machen ein „Speed Dating“ mit dem Porsche 992. Welche Variante kann das Herz des Bachelors gewinnen?

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: A versão longa da Bentley Mulsanne é um excelente exemplo de uma limusine com chope. Com ela, a marca britânica de carros de luxo colocou a fasquia extremamente alta quando se trata de conforto automotivo.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Desde os anos 50, o Mercedes SL é considerado a lenda dos carros esportivos. Desde a lendária série 300SL, a série SL tem sido toda sobre inovação e esportividade. SL é a abreviação alemã de Super Leicht - super leve. Hoje a abreviação significa mais super luxo. No entanto, cada modelo estabeleceu a referência para o projeto e a inovação técnica.

programme.title: Luxus und Lifestyle
programme.desc: Englischer Luxus und deutscher Lifestyle. Der Bentley Bentayga EWB verwöhnt seine Fond-Passagiere mit makelloser Verarbeitung und Champagner-Kühler. Beim Mercedes CLE 53 mit Reihensechszylinder ist der beste Platz hingegen hinter dem Lenkrad.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o ícone de todos os sedãs e descapotáveis esportivos. Nenhum outro carro representa o estilo de vida dos anos 60 como o Ford Mustang. Com seu design muito especial e motor potente, o Mustang conquistou os corações de milhões de entusiastas de automóveis. A História do Automóvel mostrará a história do Ford Mustang, do primeiro protótipo ao mais recente Mustang Shelby com mais de 500 hp.

programme.title: Der 6-Zylinder ist zurück! | Up-Sizing beim Mercedes-AMG CLE 53
programme.desc: AMGs Vierzylinder-Hybrid im C63 war ein Flop – Hubraum bleibt unersetzlich. Der CLE 53 AMG setzt daher weiter auf den 6-Zylinder und ersetzt C- und E-Klasse Coupé. Ist das die Rückkehr zur AMG-DNA?

programme.title: Von den ersten Bugattis bis zum Antrieb der Zukunft | Rundgang im Autovision Museum
programme.desc: Im Automuseum Autovision bekommt man einen Einblick in die Entwicklung des Automobils, wie nirgendwo sonst. Museums-Chef Horst Schultz nimmt uns mit auf einen Rundgang durch seine Hallen mit 200 Fahrzeugen.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Os Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland e os Royals conduziram o Austin Mini. Concebido sobre um guardanapo, o Mini 1959 inicia uma trajetória incrível: o revolucionário e original Mini é considerado o protótipo para todos os carros pequenos. A História do Automóvel mostra toda a grande história do Mini, desde o Mini original até o Rally-Mini de hoje.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Há um carro que todos conhecem. Um carro ao qual foi dado um apelido e que nunca mais foi chamado de outra coisa: O Besouro VW. Com mais de 60 anos, ele nos conta mais sobre nosso século do que muitos livros de história. A História do Automóvel conta a história do Carocha indestrutível, desde o primeiro modelo de 24,5 cv até o último modelo do Novo Carocha.

programme.title: Dacia Spring: Was kann das günstigste E-Auto Europas?
programme.desc: Seit den 2000ern ist Dacia vor allem in Europa dafür bekannt, die günstigsten Neuwagen überhaupt anzubieten. Jetzt gilt das auch für das günstigste E-Auto Europas. Der Dacia Spring verspricht mit bis zu 305 km Reichweite eine kostengünstige Alternative zu Renault Twingo E-Tech Electric oder Corsa e zu sein. Wo ist der Haken?

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia do carro - Ferrari
programme.desc: Ferrari... somente o nome faz seu coração correr. Seja na estrada ou na pista de corrida, onde quer que você queira que o carro com o emblema do cavalo de corrida ligue seu motor ruidoso, ele será sempre o centro das atenções. A história automotiva mostrará a história deste corredor vermelho "Maranellesi" - desde o primeiro carro esportivo até o último Ferrari FF.

programme.title: Der 6-Zylinder ist zurück! | Up-Sizing beim Mercedes-AMG CLE 53
programme.desc: AMGs Vierzylinder-Hybrid im C63 war ein Flop – Hubraum bleibt unersetzlich. Der CLE 53 AMG setzt daher weiter auf den 6-Zylinder und ersetzt C- und E-Klasse Coupé. Ist das die Rückkehr zur AMG-DNA?

programme.title: Offroad-Test extrem! Wir fahren Can-Am Outlander und Maverick R in Portugal
programme.desc: Diese Funmobile bezwingen jeglichen Untergrund. Der Can-Am Outlander und Maverick R sind die ultimativen Geräte für grenzenlosen Offroad-Spaß. Wir testen beide in Portugal und plaudern außerdem mit Daniel Abt und Extrem-Mountainbiker Fabio Wibmer.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: Neue Ära für Mercedes: Weltpremiere des CLA in Rom - Design, Technik, Preis etc.
programme.desc: Er ist der Vorreiter einer neuen Mercedes-Welt! Der CLA soll Bestwerte in Sachen Reichweite, Verbrauch und Ladeleistung bieten. Wir waren bei der Weltpremiere in Rom und verraten Details zu Technik, Design und auch, was Popstar will.i.am von ihm hält.

programme.title: Saab 93 e Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: Em 1937, foi fundada na Suécia uma empresa fabricante de aviões que mais tarde se tornou a famosa fabricante de automóveis Saab. Apresentamos dois de seus modelos icônicos de carros, o Saab 93 e o 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Um carro único: O Beradino
programme.desc: Uma "bella macchina", um belo carro - mas não projetado por mestres como Bertone ou Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen de Neuss na Alemanha construiu o Beradino à mão.

programme.title: September Dawn
programme.desc: Im Jahre 1857 reist ein Zug von Siedlern durch Utah und wird von den dort ansässigen religiös-faschistoiden Mormonen, die die Einwanderer nicht dulden wollen, angegriffen. Am Rande dieses tragischen Massakers bei dem rund 140 Menschen ihr Leben lassen, kommt es zu einer Romeo & Juliet ähnlichen Liebesgeschichte zwischen der Tochter des Siedler-Pastors und einem jungen Mormonen.

programme.title: Behaving Badly: Brav sein war gestern
programme.desc: Rick (Nat Wolff) zählt in dieser Teenagerkomödie an seiner High-School nicht zu den beliebtesten Schülern. Um das zu ändern, versucht er seinen High-School-Schwarm Nina (Selena Gomez) ins Bett zu bekommen. Mit seinem Mitschüler Karlis Malinauskas (Nate Hartley) geht er eine Wette ein: Innerhalb von zwei Wochen muss Rick Nina rumbekommen. Auf dem Konzert von Ninas Lieblingsmusiker Josh Groban versucht Rick seine Chance zu nutzen und sie zu verführen. Aber auf dem Konzert ist auch Ninas eifersüchtiger Ex-Freund und vermasselt ihm die Tour. Doch nach dem geplatzten Date treffen sich die beiden immer öfter und es entwickelt sich mehr als nur eine Freundschaft zwischen den beiden. Schnell muss Rick sich eingestehen, dass das Ziel für ihn nicht mehr nur darin besteht, Nina ins Bett zu bekommen.

programme.title: Miss Viborg
programme.desc: In einer dänischen Kleinstadt treffen wir zwei Generationen von Frauen. Die 61-jährige Solvej und die 17-jährige Kate. Ihre Begegnung ist der Beginn einer unwahrscheinlichen Freundschaft, denn die Wunden der Vergangenheit werden aufgedeckt.

programme.title: Highway Heat
programme.desc: Der entflohene Sträfling Jack Hammond nimmt eine Frau als Geisel und macht sich mit der Polizei auf den Weg zur mexikanischen Grenze.

programme.title: Das Urteil
programme.desc: Bei einem schweren Verkehrsunfall verliert Anwalt McClain seine Frau und seine beiden Söhne. Er selbst überlebt. Doch sein Dasein erscheint ihm nun völlig sinnlos. Aber dann übernimmt er den Fall eines jungen Mannes, der wegen Mordes zum Tod verurteilt werden soll. Während er vor Gericht für das Leben seines Klienten kämpft, findet er selbst allmählich ins Leben zurück. Dabei hilft ihm auch die verständnisvolle Anna, eine kompetente Psychologin und Seelsorgerin, die vor Jahren selbst einen schweren Verlust verarbeiten musste. Mit ihrer Hilfe erkennt Mac schließlich, dass Gott noch einen Plan für sein Leben hat.

programme.title: Tödliches Verlangen
programme.desc: Angela (Gina Gershon) und Brian (Nicolas Cage) leben den amerikanischen Traum in einem luxuriösen Traumhaus mit Pool. Umgeben von attraktiven Freunden scheint auch ihr privates Glück fast perfekt. Nur der sehnliche Wunsch nach einer kinderreichen Familie bleibt unerfüllt. Deshalb soll die hübsche Katie (Nicky Whelan) als Leihmutter für das zweite Kind diese Lücke füllen. Doch schon bald entsteht eine beunruhigende Spannung aus sexuellem Verlangen und Eifersucht und Angela ahnt, dass Katie ein dunkles Geheimnis hütet. Ein abgründiges Katz- und Maus-Spiel setzt sich in Gang und droht das Glück von Angela und Brian zu zerstören...

programme.title: Angel - I Will Find You
programme.desc: Die verstorbene Francesca (Angela Sarafyan) kehrt zurück auf die Erde und zieht als Engel durch die Welt der Lebenden. Sie ist verantwortlich dafür, dass die Menschen, die sie trifft anschließend entweder ein glücklicheres Leben führen oder aber ein baldiges tragisches Ende im Tod finden. Dabei darf sie sich jedoch nie auf eine emotionale Bindung einlassen. Dies erschwert ihre geheime Suche nach dem Menschen, den sie noch immer liebt und von dem sie sich zu Lebzeiten nie richtig verabschieden konnte...

programme.title: Astral City
programme.desc: Als der Arzt Dr. André Luiz seine Augen aufschlägt, muss er erkennen, dass er tot ist. In einer bedrohlich wirkenden Wüste beginnt seine abenteuerliche Reise. Bald betritt er dort die mysteriöse Astral City, die die Einwohner als ihr Heim bezeichnen. Er scheint nicht im Himmel angekommen zu sein, sondern in einer spirituellen Dimension. Luiz ist also nicht am Ende seiner Reise angekommen, sondern vielmehr am Anfang. Ein Meisterwerk des brasilianischen Kinos voller atemberaubender Effekte!

programme.title: The Idealist - Geheimakte Grönland
programme.desc: Im Januar 1968 stürzt ein amerikanischer B52-Bomber über dänischem Hoheitsgebiet im grönländischen Thule nahe eines US-Luftwaffenstützpunktes ab und wird kurz darauf als Atomunfall deklariert. Die Verantwortlichen beteuern, die Situation unter Kontrolle zu haben. Nach den acht Monate andauernden und aufwendigen Aufräumarbeiten sind das Flugzeugwrack sowie das mit Plutonium kontaminierte Gletschereis beseitigt und der Fall wird zu den Akten gelegt. Erst dem Journalisten Poul Brink fallen 18 Jahre danach Ungereimtheiten auf. Unter der Eiskappe in Grönland und in den Archiven der US-Regierung scheint die bittere Wahrheit über den Absturz zu liegen. Also beginnt der ehrgeizige Reporter mit der Recherche und zieht dabei allzu bald die Aufmerksamkeit der Verantwortlichen des Unfalls auf sich – und die sehen seine ersten erfolgreichen Enthüllungen gar nicht gern...

programme.title: Wayne’s World
programme.desc: Wayne und Garth haben im örtlichen offenen TV-Kanal ihre eigene Fernsehsendung. Ein schmieriger Produzent erkennt das kultige Potenzial der Show und engagiert die beiden Chaoten für eine professionelle Sendung, die von einem großen Videospiele-Hersteller gesponsort werden soll. In der Zwischenzeit trifft Wayne auch auf die attraktive Cassandra, für die er sogar Kantonesisch lernt. Doch zwischen die beiden kommt immer wieder der Produzent.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Zwei Jahre nach dem amerikanischen Bürgerkrieg kehrt Jack Sommersby (Richard Gere) auf seine Farm in Tennessee zurück. Seine Frau Laurel (Jodie Foster) glaubt ihn längst tot und hat einem Nachbarn die Ehe versprochen. Jetzt ist sie überrascht, wie positiv Jack sich verändert hat. War er früher roh, gewalttätig und ließ die Felder verkommen, überschüttet er sie nun mit Liebe und Zärtlichkeit. Die Ernte ist erfolgreich und auch die Bürger der Stadt sind von Sommersby angetan. Als Zweifel an seiner Identität aufkommen, wendet sich das Schicksal gegen ihn: Jack Sommersby wird des Mordes angeklagt. Wer ist dieser unheimliche Heimkehrer wirklich?

programme.desc: David Herdeg (Brad Johnson), der überlebende Held, hat sich und seinem jungen Sohn ein Leben aufgebaut, das schnell aus den Fugen gerät. Das US-Militär führt ein weiteres Experiment durch – eines, das nicht nur Herdegs DNA verändert, sondern auch das gesamte Universum bedroht. Das Ziel des Experiments ist es, einen Tarnkappenjäger zurück nach 1943 zu transportieren, um ihn als ultimative Kriegsmaschine zu benutzen. Stattdessen wird Herdeg in eine andere Zeitschleife geworden: Es ist immer noch 1993, aber in dieser Welt hat Deutschland den Krieg gewonnen. Kann Herdeg im Wettlauf gegen die Zeit seinen Sohn – und die Welt – aus einer schrecklichen Zukunft retten? Oder wird die Zukunft eine verdrehte Realität sein, die durch das Philadelphia-Experiment verzerrt wird?

programme.title: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: Zoey, a cyber crime specialist doesn't seem to connect with her detective husband Dave anymore, but they try to make it work for their 6-year-old son Timmy. While in the middle of a complicated stalker case, Zoey realizes that those long nights at work were actually an excuse for Dave to be messing around, and Zoey ends up kicking Dave out. programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town; and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: A cop-turned-writer creates suspicion when she publishes her first novel containing details of a real murder.

programme.title: Deadly Daycare
programme.desc: After a few years of financial hardship, a young mother (RACHEL) decides to go back to work to help her ex-husband with the mounting bills. With no one to watch their 4-year-old daughter (MIA), the mother decides to enroll her into the local daycare center called Little Ones owned by a seemingly responsible older woman, (DEBORAH). After a few weeks of Mia's awkward behavior, Rachel concludes her daughter may be getting mistreated by (GABBY) one of the centers daycare teachers.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 127: Gabriel teme perder a Marisela
programme.desc: Gabriel va a ver a su tío Braulio y le dice que cree que ha perdido a Marisela y a sus hijos. Cachita escucha que Isadora es llamada hija por Volcán y la última admite que ambas provienen de una familia de prostitutas. Isabela está conversando con Abril, Luly y Mirna cuando llega Tomás a buscarla para salir, se van y Luly los acompaña. Mientras Abril se queda con Mirna llega una joven por el aviso que han colocado en la prensa. Cachita le pregunta a Volcán de dónde han sacado al bebé que tiene Isadora. Braulio trata de tranquilizar a su sobrino Gabriel. Marisela amamanta a su hijita mientras conversa con su hijo, ella no lo recuerda cuando bebé, Jesús les dice que él le sacaba los gases a Ricardo después de ser amamantado por Marisela.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 170: Separacion y planes de boda inesperados
programme.desc: Gonzalo estalla cuando Matilde le pide que se separen. Paco y María Antonia, Doroteo y María José planean casarse.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 115: Alfredo Descubre la Verdad de Marisela
programme.desc: Marisela sintiéndose temerosa de descubrir quienes son sus padres por quienes guarda tanto resentimiento le designa la difícil tarea a Alfredo. Flavia se siente intrigada al ignorar si Marisela la descubrió ya su identidad como su madre. Emperatriz conversa con Luis Guillermo sintiéndose desesperada por reencontrarse con sus hijas Betania e Inés. Alfredo accede a la petición de Marisela enterándose por fin de quienes son los padres de su futura esposa. Luis Guillermo le promete a Emperatriz velar por la seguridad de sus hijas en tanto se lleva a cabo su reunión con ellas, Flavia sintiéndose afectada por el comportamiento de su familia en contra de Emperatriz advierte a Luis Guillermo del silencio que estos mantuvieron durante tanto tiempo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Asesinan a dos reclusas en la cárcel donde está Virginia. Jimena se entera de esto y va a la cárcel, junto con Carlos Ernesto, quién la sigue, y ella termina confesando que recibió una llamada de alguien que ofrecía asesinar a Virginia. La directora de la cárcel termina deteniendo a Jimena. Felipe va a la casa de los Ferrándiz para avisarle a Irene de lo sucedido en la cárcel y Agustina sorprende a Felipe y a Irene abrazándose. La acusa con Leandro, pero este toma partido por Irene y echa de la casa a Agustina. Ella le pide ayuda a su sobrino Leo ofreciéndole a cambio revelarle un secreto familiar.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Columba y Raúla discuten acerca de la escapada de Sol con Alejandro. Mientras tanto, Sol y Alejandro se besan en un lugar remoto. Sol lo rechaza delicadamente y Alejandro decide que deben volver y respetar la decisión de ella. Don Eloy le informa a Maricielo que ha pagado la deuda y que la casa donde vive su familia ahora le pertenece. Alicia va a provocar a Carlos a su estudio y luego lo lleva hasta la prisión donde él le informa a su madre que saldrá en libertad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo visita a Trinidad en la clínica. Ella desconfía de las intenciones de Leonardo y de la familia Ferrándiz en general. Le asegura que su hija, Virginia, es inocente. Leonardo le garantiza que se equivoca, que la situación de Virginia es muy incómoda para todos. Irene, junto con Felipe, van a visitar a Jimena y a Carlos Ernesto. Estos últimos le dicen a Irene que se alegran de que Virginia esté sana y salva por los asesinatos en la prisión. Jimena le asegura a Irene que no es cómplice del hecho. Irene le cree. Leo desconfía de su tía Agustina, la trata de mentirosa. Ella se desespera y le asegura poseer un secreto muy importante. Leo le asegura que nadie la va a echar de la casa. programme.title: Três Ladrões e Um Bebê
programme.desc: Para o compulsivo jogador de Slipper Jackie Chan, existe apenas uma coisa mais aterrorizante do que os credores o som do choro de um bebê. Mas e se um bebê se transformase no salvador de suas dívidas? Sua fobia por fraldas, mamadeiras e canções de ninar desapareceria? Essa oportunidade surge quando, junto com seu senhorio e o oportunista Octopus, seqüestra BB, o neto de um magnata. Mas sem saber, eles frustram os planos da tríade. Assim que descobrem que a tríade está no seu encalço, eles, com a ajuda da doce enfermeira Melody, da esposa do senhorio louco por bebês e Pat Yin, fã adolescente de Octopus. Slipper resolve transformar o bebê refém em seu protegido. Encurralados pelos policiais e perseguidos por gângsteres perigosos, este trio embarca numa arrepiante, perigosa e delirantemente engraçada fuga para colocar BB de volta em seu berço são e salvo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.desc: The Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog 24/7

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: Jogos de Inventar
programme.desc: Um espaço em branco é preenchido com cores, sons e movimentos, de acordo com a imaginação de Juju, Miro, Quique, Shay, Migui e Dodó, que inventam jogos ao desvendar um livro muito divertido.

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Eles podem ser chamados de Curtas, mas com eles a diversão não é nada curta. Junte-se às sensações mundiais, Talking Tom and Friends, nessa série ágil e divertida, onde os seus jogos preferidos ganham vida diante dos seus olhos! Veja as aventuras hilariantes deles e prepare-se para sorrir sem parar!

programme.title: Cante com o Bubu
programme.desc: A série musical da Coruja Pequena está repleta de músicas super divertidas de alta qualidade, escritas com cuidado, talento e originalidade. Cada uma delas vem em um estilo musical diferente para que as crianças possam aprender e se divertir cantando junto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger é uma série animada em 3D vibrante e envolvente, criada para crianças de 1 a 8 anos, que dá vida às aventuras do dia a dia por meio de músicas cativantes e encantadoras. Com uma variedade de personagens coloridos e temas ricos e diversos, a série retrata os momentos alegres da vida da família BarryTiger. A produção musical de alta qualidade — com melodias, arranjos e interpretações de excelência — adiciona ainda mais diversão às cenas animadas e sempre surpreendentes. Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e explorar com Barry e seus amigos em cada episódio emocionante!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Confira as compilações do Angry Birds Toons! Cada compilação tem vários episódios de seus programas favoritos, incluindo Angry Birds, Piggy Tales e Stella!

programme.title: Universo Z
programme.desc: Universo Z combina animação com live action, abordando temas universais com valores positivos e incentivando a realização de atividades manuais às crianças da primeira infância.

programme.title: O Reino Infantil
programme.desc: Seus personagens favoritos de O Reino Infantil estão esperando por você neste novo episódio para cantar e dançar com as músicas e os episódios mais divertidos!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids é uma série musical animada em 3D que dá vida às alegres e afetuosas aventuras diárias da família Domi, composta por cinco membros. Com músicas animadas e divertidas, e performances de vários personagens, o programa oferece uma ampla variedade de temas, histórias envolventes e cenários diversificados. A equipe profissional de produção musical garante melodias de alta qualidade, arranjos cativantes e interpretações vocais impecáveis, proporcionando um verdadeiro banquete audiovisual para as crianças. O conteúdo é positivo, divertido e pensado para ajudar as crianças a aprenderem e explorarem o mundo de forma apropriada para sua idade. Também apoia os pais em sua jornada de uma criação mais leve e prazerosa, acompanhando o crescimento e o florescimento dos pequenos

programme.title: Sopa de Letrinhas

programme.title: Destination Dive

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"
programme.desc: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: With the fall of the Soviet Union, wildlife populations in Tajikistan were devastated, bringing some of their unique mountain species to the brink of extinction. With the help of funds generated through hunting, vast areas are now being conserved and protected. Dan Cabela explores this conservation success.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Larken and Michael set out on a Florida Man adventure in part 1 of this 2 part series. Join them in the Florida keys and Everglades for an experience that few get to experience.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In this inaugural episode, host Ryan McVinney takes viewers to the outer reaches of Cape Cod, Massachusetts to meet a local group of boaters affectionately referred to as the “The Tin Boat Mafia”. This heart-warming family story of aluminum boat owners who share a love for the outdoors and nature is particularly moving during the COVID-19 pandemic. From fishing and surfing to sun bathing and collecting driftwood, this episode chronicles the group’s passion for the water and demonstrates why light-weight, easy-to-handle, shallow draft aluminum fishing boats are their vessels of choice for navigating the sandbars of Cape Cod, MA.

programme.title: The Cast

programme.title: Goin' Coastal

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Northern Maine to hunt for moose and learn about the conservation of this species which is under attack by winter ticks. Can reducing moose numbers be the key to saving the local moose population from this deadly parasite?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green is joined by his childhood friends in his home state of Michigan for a trout fishing adventure. They visit the most dynamic landmarks in the Upper Peninsula, do a little cliff jumping, and finish out the trip cooking trout riverside.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. Having already checked off nine species in Argentina, he now finds himself in Peru, where he faces the challenge of tracking down two elusive species to complete his list: the Andean Tinamou and the Western Peruvian Dove.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Hunting Giant Eurasian Brown Bear in Croatia"
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he embarks on a thrilling hunt in Croatia for the Eurasian Brown Bear. Experience the beauty of the Croatian wilderness and witness the skill and precision required for a successful hunt. Follow along as Mark faces all the challenges dealing with wind and a big bear that is extremely smart, making it very difficult to harvest this amazing animal. Don’t miss this exciting hunting adventure with Mark Peterson in Croatia!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Freak Show - Largest Buck I’ve Ever Encountered"
programme.desc: The hunt for FREAK SHOW became a thrilling adventure after I spotted him on Cabela’s trail cam. Having hunted Kentucky for over a decade and established my own properties—Bootleggers Ridge and Stonewall Plantation—I was eager for the chance at such a remarkable deer. Despite having drawn a coveted caribou tag through Worldwide Trophy Adventures’ TAGS Program, the allure of FREAK SHOW was too strong to resist. After careful planning and waiting for the right wind, I finally - set out on September 11. With my crossbow in hand, I waited anxiously in the stand, my heart racing as the shadows lengthened. Just when I thought the evening might end without a sighting, a movement caught my eye, sending my pulse soaring. With caution, FREAK SHOW appeared.
